concerns.text: FR-003 and SC-002 require VIF calculation and reporting. Tasks T019c (determine comparison status) and T019d (write VIF results to model_results.json) are marked unchecked [ ]. Without these, the VIF verification logic is incomplete and the artifact is not produced.

FR-006 requires a causal language scan that halts execution. Task T020 (generate report buffer and scan) is marked unchecked [ ]. Task T021 (merge results into model_results.json) is also unchecked [ ]. The pipeline cannot enforce the 'associational' constraint or persist results without these.

FR-004 requires a sensitivity analysis matrix (3 outlier strategies x 2 confounder states). Task T024 (implement sensitivity.py with matrix runs) is marked unchecked [ ]. Task T025 (read results, calculate variation, raise error if threshold exceeded) is also unchecked [ ]. The core robustness check is missing.

FR-005 and SC-005 require visualization generation and counting. Task T027a (count generated files and flag missing ones in log) is marked unchecked [ ]. The success criterion for visualization count cannot be verified.

FR-001 and SC-001 require directory structure setup. Tasks T001a (create directory structure) and T001b (init __init__.py) are marked unchecked [ ]. Task T004 (detailed directory structure) is also unchecked [ ]. The project foundation is incomplete.

FR-008 requires a measurement model formula. Task T015b (ensure formula is importable) is marked unchecked [ ]. While T015a defines it, T015b is required to ensure usability by other modules as per the plan's dependency chain.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires linting/formatting config. Task T003 (configure linting/formatting) is marked unchecked [ ]. This violates the reproducibility requirement for pinned tool configurations.

Task T021 description states 'Do not overwrite the existing vif_results section', but T019d (which creates the file) is unchecked. This creates a logical dependency gap where the file T021 expects to append to may not exist.
